_note: Public repository: GitHub minutes are unlimited, so held shares are watched live all day for the stop and there is no minutes limit. For a private repository (2,000 free minutes a month) set watch_holding_days to false and monthly_minute_budget to 1650.
_note_buy_hours: whole_day = 5 slices 9:30 am - 2:00 pm (as tested for 5 years); morning = 5 slices 9:30 - 11:30 am, about half the GitHub minutes per buy day.
_note_fixed_limit: Margin per share for the live paper test, fixed at Rs 50,000 (cash trades with a dividend of 1.5% or more get twice this). Remove it (or set null) to use 10% of capital at each quarter's start.
_note_tier2: Dividends of Rs 500-2,500 cr have priority. Rs 2,500-8,000 cr dividends are bought only with idle money: after paying the margin, at least 20% of the account must stay free for Rs 500-2,500 cr dividends. Set tier2_max_mcap to 2500 to switch the extra range off.
